opening: My right eye has been red.
Bright light bothers my right eye.
The vision in my right eye is slightly blurry.
The light sensitivity, the pain and the blurriness started 3 days ago.
Since I started CPAP, my right eye has felt drier than usual when I wake up.
Six months ago I had SMILE laser vision correction on both eyes, with no complications.
Two weeks ago I started using a CPAP machine at night.

opening.text: My right eye has been red for 5 days, and the light sensitivity, pain, and slight blurriness started 3 days ago. Bright light bothers it, and it hurts. Six months ago I had SMILE laser vision correction on both eyes with no complications, but two weeks ago I started using a CPAP machine at night, and since then my right eye has felt drier than usual when I wake up.
